title: pvRedistributeDataSet
body:
## pvRedistributeDataSet

Load-balances a dataset across MPI processes: it computes spatial cuts for the requested number of partitions and moves cells accordingly, assigning boundary cells to one region (ParaView default), duplicating them (marked as duplicate ghost cells) or splitting them. Output is an unstructured grid per process, or a vtkPartitionedDataSet with PreservePartitionsInOutput, and global cell ids can be generated. With default settings a serial run has one partition, so the main effect is conversion to an unstructured grid. It is the newer alternative to pvD3.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- Image, rectilinear and structured grids become explicit unstructured grids, which can need much more memory; ParaView warns about this.
- Schemaxis serial examples do not establish MPI behaviour. Schemaxis generates this binding from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for this operation.

Native constructor: `RedistributeDataSet`. Identity: `filters/RedistributeDataSet`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

| Port | Meaning / native port | Required | Multiplicity | Kind | Contract |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Input` | Required data input for the native Input port. Give the name of the upstream node to connect, or a {node, port} object to use another of its output ports. Accepted data: any dataset (meshes, grids, point sets) (vtkDataSet). | True | one object | `data` | `{"compatibility":"native-domain-checked","composite":null,"cost":{"basis":"no benchmark","conversion":"none inserted","rating":"unknown"},"nativeTypes":["vtkDataSet"],"requirements":{},"traits":{"contiguity":"unknown","indexing":"unknown","iteration":"unknown"}}` |

### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `BoundaryMode` | This property determines how cells that lie on processor boundaries are handled. The "Assign to one region" option assigns each boundary cell to exactly one process, which is useful for isosurfacing. Selecting "Assign to all regions" causes the cells on the boundaries to be copied to each process that shares that boundary. The "Split cells" option breaks cells across process boundary lines so that pieces of the cell lie in different processes. This option is useful for volume rendering. | `{"type":"enum","values":["Assign to one region","Assign to all regions","Split cells"]}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `"Assign to one region"` |
| `EnableDebugging` | Retains some helper arrays created for generating global cell Ids and ghost cells that are useful for debugging. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `GenerateGlobalCellIds` | Generate global Ids for all cells across partitions. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `LoadBalanceAcrossAllBlocks` | When checked, for datasets with multiple blocks, the filter will try to load balance across all blocks otherwise each block is separately load balanced. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `NumberOfPartitions` | Requested number of spatial partitions. Any negative value, including ParaView's default -1, uses the number of MPI processes (one in a serial run); a positive value is a hint, which ParaView documents as rounded up to a power of two. | `{"minimum":-1,"type":"integer"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `-1` |
| `PreservePartitionsInOutput` | When unchecked, ranks with more than one partition will merge the partitions into a single vtkUnstructuredGrid. When checked, the partitions are preserved and the output is a vtkPartitionedDataSet. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |

Execution contract:

```json
{
  "mode": "serial",
  "performance": "unknown"
}
```

  "defaults": "native defaults for omitted options",
  "gaps": {},

### Syntax example

Place in `nodes`. Data outputs may be selected by a scene; resource outputs must be connected to a compatible consumer.

```json
{
  "id": "result",
  "filter": "pvRedistributeDataSet",
  "inputs": {
    "Input": "UPSTREAM_Input"
  }
}
```
